procedures.title: Receiving and storage of ingredients
procedures.purpose: Only certified ingredients enter the kitchen
steps: Check every delivery against the approved ingredient list
Check the halal certificate covers the exact product and is not expired
Store food on the food shelf only; chemicals on a separate shelf

procedures.title: Cleaning and sanitation
steps: Wash wok, blender and table after each batch
Display a hand-wash sign at the sink
Follow a weekly cleaning schedule posted on the wall

procedures.title: Preventing contamination
procedures.purpose: Keep non-halal and non-food items away from production
steps: Do not bring any non-halal food into the production kitchen
Keep detergents and household items in a separate cupboard
Identify and label or remove any unlabelled container

procedures.title: Traceability
procedures.purpose: Trace each jar back to its ingredient purchases
steps: Write a batch number on each jar
Record the invoices used for each batch
Keep receipts for every market purchase

procedures.title: Certificate expiry control
procedures.purpose: Never use an ingredient with an expired certificate
steps: Keep a list of supplier certificates and expiry dates
Ask the supplier for renewal 90 days before expiry
Stop using the ingredient if the certificate lapses

halal_policy_draft.text: Kedai Sambal Contoh commits to producing only halal food. We use only ingredients with valid halal certification, keep our kitchen free of non-halal materials, keep records for every batch, and train everyone who handles our food.
